title: Azure AI Fundamentals
subtitle: Guess the hidden AI terms — spin for consonants, buy vowels

gradeLabels.f: F-RANK -- Back to the Training Data

puzzles.hint: Training a model on labeled examples to predict future outcomes
puzzles.explain: Supervised learning uses labeled training data — input features paired with known correct outputs — so the model learns a mapping it can apply to new, unseen data. Regression and classification are the two main task types covered in AI-900.

puzzles.hint: Microsoft's six-principle framework guiding ethical AI development
puzzles.explain: Microsoft's Responsible AI framework defines six principles: Fairness, Reliability and Safety, Privacy and Security, Inclusiveness, Transparency, and Accountability. AI-900 tests candidates' ability to identify which principle applies to a given scenario.

puzzles.hint: Locating and labeling multiple items within a single image using bounding boxes
puzzles.explain: Object detection goes beyond image classification by identifying what objects are present and where they appear, returning a bounding box and confidence score for each detected item. Azure AI Vision and Custom Vision both support this capability.

puzzles.hint: Determining whether a piece of text expresses a positive, negative, or neutral opinion
puzzles.explain: Sentiment analysis is a natural language processing technique that assigns an opinion polarity score to text, such as customer reviews or social-media posts. Azure AI Language provides a built-in sentiment analysis feature that returns document- and sentence-level scores.

puzzles.hint: A deep-learning model trained on vast text corpora that generates coherent language
puzzles.explain: Large language models are transformer-based neural networks trained on billions of tokens of text, enabling them to generate, summarize, translate, and reason about language. Azure OpenAI Service hosts large language models such as the GPT series for enterprise use. Mechanistically, an LLM works by predicting the most probable NEXT TOKEN in a sequence, one token at a time, which underlies its ability to generate, summarize, translate, and reason about language.

puzzles.hint: Microsoft's cloud platform for building, training, and deploying ML models at scale
puzzles.explain: Azure Machine Learning is a managed cloud service that provides tools for data preparation, automated ML, experiment tracking, model registration, and real-time or batch inferencing. AI-900 covers its Designer canvas and Automated ML wizard as no-code entry points.

puzzles.hint: A table showing true positives, true negatives, false positives, and false negatives
puzzles.explain: A confusion matrix summarizes a classification model's performance by tallying correct and incorrect predictions across each class. Metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score are all derived from its four cells.

puzzles.hint: Grounding a language model's answers in documents fetched from an external knowledge store
puzzles.explain: Retrieval Augmented Generation combines a vector search over a private document corpus with a large language model, feeding retrieved passages as context so the model produces factually grounded responses. This pattern reduces hallucinations and is central to Azure AI Search integrations covered in AI-900.
